first_reader_said: NEH 12:1: Both records are the priest Jeremiah who came up with Zerubbabel and Jeshua and was ancestor of Hananiah (12:12), with the same family links.
NEH 12:12: Both records are the priestly house of Jeremiah headed by Hananiah under Joiakim, with the same links.

why: Both records identify the Jeremiah who returned with Zerubbabel and Jeshua in NEH 12:1, whose priestly house was represented by Hananiah under Joiakim in NEH 12:12. B repeats A's verses and family links without identifying a separate person. NEH 10:2 and NEH 12:34 supply no contrasting father or lineage that distinguishes these records; A preserves the fuller account.
